description: Time-boxed spikes that must pass before feature work (plan.md §13 Phase 0), on Android and iOS. WebGPU exposed without flags in the Even WebView, and acceptable speaker-embedding performance on WebGPU or WASM, are product blockers per platform. Failure of live STT performance only changes the default tier (capture-now/process-later or Soniox).
title: MVP Phase 0: Feasibility spikes
